name: The Traveler
source:
The traveler's sex, name, and appearance - including skin color and hair length - can all be customized by the player. However, in all cases, the traveler is friendly, helpful, optimistic, curious, and displays a mixture of naivity and wisdom.

The traveler has no formal education, and plans to be a farmer; possibly a baker.

The traveler is only seen at a distance, or in silhouette.
